capabilities: Render web UI wireframes inline from YAML in ui-sketch code blocks
Compose screens from 45 components across 8 categories
Switch wireframes between desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports
Surface YAML and component errors with line numbers and typo suggestions
Inherit Obsidian theme colors via CSS variables
disambiguation: Not a Figma replacement — a fast mid-fi sketching tool that lives inside your notes.
extras: Pre-release installs are supported via BRAT; release assets are signed with GitHub artifact attestations; the author asks for GitHub sponsorships; full documentation lives in the repo's docs/ folder, not the README alone.
motivation: The author wanted one artifact that humans can skim, readers can see rendered, and AI tools can consume and revise as structured data instead of decoding ASCII rectangles.
problem: People describing screens in Markdown fall back to ASCII box drawings that are slow to edit, misalign easily, and are unreadable as structured data for scripts and LLMs.
summary: YAML-based wireframe renderer that draws mid-fidelity web UI mockups inline in notes from ui-sketch code blocks, with 45 components and inline error reporting.
